summary: Explains the Subtitles and Closed Captions plugin: subtitle assets/AssetUserData with duration, offset, priority and type, display via a TextBlock widget set in Project Settings, the Blueprint/C++ queue/stop API, Sequencer subtitle tracks, SRT import and migration from legacy SoundWave/DialogueWave subtitles.
gotchas: Plugin and migration tool are Beta; plugin must be enabled in UE
UseSoundDuration only works when the subtitle is AssetUserData on a SoundBase asset
Duration must be >= 0.05 s; only one subtitle per category displays, highest priority wins
Queue/Stop calls are marshaled to the Game Thread and run asynchronously
new_in_59: Subtitles embedded as AssetUserData in localized Waves from 5.8 or earlier must be migrated (Migrate Embedded Subtitles to Asset, then Fix Localized Subtitle Waves).

Create New Skeletal Mesh Asset from Mesh

Make Geometry Script Create New Skeletal Mesh Asset Options

summary: Shows how to write custom Visual Dataprep filters and operators as Blueprint classes, listing the fetcher/operation base classes and which functions to override (Fetch, On Execution, display name, category).

All elements in a filter regenerate together when the Dataflow graph is evaluated
